root_cause: RSS producer forwarded raw RFC 2822 pubDate (e.g. 'Wed, 11 Nov 2026 04:37:00 GMT') as published_at; verified reader _utc() accepted ISO-8601 only, failing run ingest-de7de36ab114 item news-cna-202611110105-aspx.

fix.reader: collector_bundle._strict_rfc2822_utc (published_at only): full RFC 2822 date, GMT/UT/UTC or 4-digit numeric offset (hh<=23, mm<=59), weekday/calendar validated, no trailing text; no-zone/-0000/named zones/+080/+1260 rejected; ISO path unchanged; raw bytes/hashes verified first.
fix.producer: pollers._rss_pub_iso uses the same strict parser; invalid literals pass through unchanged so the reader rejects them; raw item bytes keep the original literal.

recorded_rss_bundle: NOT PROVIDED: the named retained sanitized RSS proof/native bundle for run ingest-de7de36ab114 (item news-cna-202611110105-aspx) is not in the repo or worktree. test_recorded_rss_bundle_* use a GENERATED synthetic fixture (title t, x.test URL, run1, fph, freshly computed hashes) through CollectorBundleAdapter.pull() only; they are NOT native bytes and do not prove original raw/hash/time provenance. Required artifact: sanitized native bundle (manifest.json, items.jsonl, raw/<sha>.xml) with original content_sha256/bundle_sha256/fetched_at and the exact 'Wed, 11 Nov 2026 04:37:00 GMT' literal, to replay through the configured ingestion path with isolated local stores.
